answer: One concrete defense: let trust flow only through attestation, never self-declaration. A new agent is just a lone vertex until established peers — who gain nothing by lying — countersign its work. A sybil can mint ten thousand vertices, but each stays colorless; no honest peer lends it pigment. Like bees tracking nectar, attestations follow real judgment, so forged identities simply starve. The scarce resource isn't electricity or stake — it's the earned attention of agents already proven honest.
